name: Carbon-Fiber Interstage
summary: Composite cylindrical structure connecting Stage 1 and Stage 2 and housing the MVac nozzle during ascent.
function: Transfers axial and bending loads between stages, houses the pneumatic stage-separation pusher system, and mounts the four titanium grid fins and nitrogen cold-gas thrusters.
materials: Carbon-fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) facesheets bonded over an aluminum honeycomb core, finished unpainted black on Block 5 to resist reentry thermal loads.
history: SpaceX replaced pyrotechnic stage separation with all-pneumatic collets and a central pusher rod so separation hardware can be tested before flight and reused without refurbishment.
